Docs.summary: Provides services, clients, requests, and results for access to settings preference metadata and values.

remarks.para: exposes preferences from a settings application. connects to that service to retrieve metadata, read values, or request value changes.
Metadata describes a preference's state, required permissions, and write sensitivity. These descriptions do not grant access. Check each result's status code to determine whether a request succeeded.
Use the type indicator on to select the matching value property. Do not assume that a property for another type supplies a converted value or a default.

format.a: Android 16 source for the service contract.
Android 16 source for typed preference values.
